best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Too soft, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 52 kJ, 6 s period, workable consistency 60/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; Meio da Baia may feel too soft without more push; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
best.shortExplanation: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  It looks too soft to make the drive worthwhile.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.

ranked.explanation: Baleal looks like a small window for Too soft, Low confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 30 kJ, 7 s period, lully 20/100, and wind is the main risk.  A broad, forgiving beach setup with several peaks; this is best for spreading out and finding a manageable wave when the bay has enough push; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; spot surf looks too small; wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the Baleal sandbanks; Baleal looks below your bodyboard fun size; Baleal may feel too soft without more push.
